agent_name.description: Name of the agent or client drafting the ticket, such as Claude Code or Codex.

already_checked.description: Markdown bullets of what was already checked, each with its result. Start a docs check with 'Docs:', one of yours with '<your name> checked:', and one of the person's with 'I tried:'.

details.description: Markdown bullets of facts support needs: the project name, ID, region and link, links to the objects involved, SDK and version, and every required detail for the kind of request, such as a deletion query and its count. Take links from _posthogUrl. No guesses.

error.description: The exact error text and its top frames. Remove any credential and say that you removed it.

filing_reason.description:
Why a human at PostHog should look at this. Your own conclusion that it is a PostHog bug is not a reason.

* `user_asked_for_support` - The person asked to contact PostHog support
* `needs_posthog_staff` - Only PostHog staff can do or see what the person needs
* `unexplained_error` - A reproducible error the agent confirmed but cannot explain
* `user_disagrees_with_agent` - The person disagrees with the agent's answer

left_for_support.description: The one thing only PostHog can do or confirm, such as 'Delete the 3,817 events this query returns'.

request.description: What the person needs PostHog to do or answer, in one to three sentences, in their own words. Put each question they asked on its own line.
